acceptanceCriteria: The system displays the promo code discount amount for the return trip ticket in the Mozio email confirmation when a promo code is applied to a return trip order.
The system displays the promo code discount amount for both the outbound trip and the return trip in the Mozio email confirmation when a promo code is applied to a return trip order.

The system calculates the promo code discount amount for the return trip independently and shows it as a separate line item in the email confirmation, matching the format used for the outbound trip discount.

The system displays a promo code discount amount of zero for the return trip in the email confirmation when the promo code does not apply to the return portion, without omitting the discount line from the return trip section.

The system correctly renders the promo code discount for return trips when the order contains multiple line items with reversed fromStation and toStation codes (e.g., outbound AJ→UN and return UN→AJ).
The system includes the promo code discount amount for the return trip in the email confirmation regardless of whether the outbound and return trips have the same or different product codes.
The system handles the case where no promo code is applied to a return trip order by displaying the return trip fare without any promo discount line in the email confirmation.
The system displays the promo code discount for the return trip in the email confirmation using the same currency formatting and label as the outbound trip promo discount.

notes: Defect: promo code discount amount is missing or incorrectly rendered for return-trip tickets in the Mozio email confirmation. The code path flows through dispatch construction (where return-trip from/to stations are swapped in create-reservations.mappers.ts), through dispatch sanitization (mapToSanitizedMozioDispatch which maps report.price.discount), and into the email payload. The discount field is optional in SanitizedMozioDispatch and may not be populated for return-trip dispatches, or the upstream price-per-unit calculation in generate-staff-notes.mappers.ts may not correctly compute discount for isReturnTrip=true.

acceptanceCriteria: The system displays the promo code discount amount for the return trip ticket in the Mozio email confirmation when a promo code is applied to a return trip order.
The system displays the promo code discount amount for both the outbound trip and the return trip in the Mozio email confirmation when a promo code is applied to a return trip order.

The system shows the promo code discount for the return trip as a separate line item in the email confirmation, distinct from the outbound trip discount line item, and the return trip discount amount reflects the return trip's own fare and not the outbound trip's fare.

The system displays a promo code discount amount of zero for the return trip in the email confirmation when the promo code does not apply to the return portion (e.g., the promo code is restricted to the outbound product or route), without omitting the discount line from the return trip section.

The system correctly renders the promo code discount for return trips when the order contains multiple line items with reversed fromStation and toStation codes (e.g., outbound AJ→UN and return UN→AJ).
The system includes the promo code discount amount for the return trip in the email confirmation regardless of whether the outbound and return trips have the same or different product codes.
The system handles the case where no promo code is applied to a return trip order by displaying the return trip fare without any promo discount line in the email confirmation.
The system displays the promo code discount for the return trip in the email confirmation using the same currency formatting and label as the outbound trip promo discount.

When a percentage-based promo code is applied to a return trip order where the outbound and return trips have different base fares, the return trip discount amount in the email confirmation reflects the percentage applied to the return trip's fare, not the outbound trip's fare.

When the promo code discount for the return trip results in a fractional monetary value, the email confirmation displays the discount with the same decimal precision and rounding behavior as the outbound trip discount.

When the return trip dispatch data contains a null or undefined discount value, the email confirmation omits the promo discount line from the return trip section, consistent with the behavior when no promo code is applied.

notes: AC1 flagged as redundant with AC2 (AC2 subsumes it by requiring both outbound and return). AC3 revised: replaced 'calculates independently' with an observable outcome — the return discount reflects the return trip's own fare, not the outbound's — and removed the overlapping 'matching the format' clause which is already covered by AC8. AC4 revised: clarified 'does not apply to the return portion' with a concrete example (promo restricted to outbound product or route) to make it testable. Added three new ACs: (9) percentage-based promo with different base fares — ensures the return discount isn't just copied from outbound; (10) fractional/rounding precision consistency; (11) null/undefined discount edge case, drawn from the technical notes about the discount field being optional in SanitizedMozioDispatch.
